result: Cause found and fixed in the test. The CLI reports the correct path. The test's expected path was in a different spelling. Build and verify pass on Linux. I could not run it on Windows.

Failure message (log excerpt at /home/user/holyagent-work/logs/win-unremoved.log, full log at /home/user/holyagent-work/logs/full.txt):
```
expect(received).toContain(expected)
Expected: C:\Users\RUNNER~1\AppData\Local\Temp\holyagent-vcs-rql7hp\.git\holyagent\reports\assignment-0mw2fzssm-lsmg.md
Received: "State I/O failed for C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\holyagent-vcs-rql7hp\.git\holyagent\reports\...md: SystemError [ERR_FS_EISDIR] ... rm returned EISDIR"
```

Cause: the temp directory comes back from `tmpdir()` in 8.3 short form (`RUNNER~1`). The CLI reports the long form (`runneradmin`), because git resolves it. The `unremoved` entry is correct: the file is listed, `rm` fails with EISDIR, exit is 0. Only the string match fails. Separators, drive-letter case and TOON escaping are ruled out, since both sides are escaped the same way in the log. I read the CI log only; I did not read the `intent.ts` or `brief.ts` code.

Fix: the assertion now expects `await filesystem.realpath(mine.report)`. The test still asserts exit 0, the path under `unremoved`, the brief removed and the report kept. I added a one-line comment above it explaining the 8.3 temp directory.
